title: Repaint Only the Car
tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

faults.what: The background is not completely unchanged: distant parked cars, utility poles and some house details show slight shifts or reconstruction.
The formerly red rear roof spoiler appears charcoal-black rather than matching the navy-blue body.

judge.summary: The car is convincingly navy blue with natural reflections, but the spoiler is nearly black and some background details have subtly changed.

must_haves.item: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
must_haves.why: The main body panels are navy blue, although the rear roof spoiler appears charcoal-black.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
must_haves.why: The car's overall geometry, placement and existing components are retained without conspicuous distortion.

must_haves.item: Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
must_haves.why: The blue paint retains bright upper highlights, reflected houses and darker lower panels consistent with the sunlight.

must_haves.item: The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: Small changes are visible in background vehicles, poles and architectural details.

must_haves.item: The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.
must_haves.why: The output preserves the supplied image's framing and aspect ratio without visible cropping; the supplied image itself is not exactly 16:9.
